visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman is seen lying on a light gray concrete pavement, looking upwards. Surrounding her are floating pixel-art icons of a cherry, heart, camera, bow, candy, and a glass slipper, each casting a soft shadow on the ground. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit indoor studio with a white brick wall and a lamp. The woman is now sitting, wearing a light blue crop top and a dark gray skirt, holding a smartphone and addressing the camera directly. (3) A screen recording shows her using a smartphone to take a photo of herself in the initial pose on the ground. (4) The screen capture displays the Pinterest interface where she searches for 'Pixel Items' and downloads various graphical assets and shadow overlays. (5) Inside the CapCut editing application, she demonstrates the 'Overlay' function, importing the previously selected assets onto her photo. (6) She utilizes the 'Chroma Key' tool with a circular color picker to remove the white backgrounds from the pixel icons, adjusting sliders for intensity and shadows. (7) Using the 'Keyframe' tool in the editor, she creates a gentle floating motion for the icons by moving them up and down at different points on the timeline. (8) Back in the studio setting, she smiles and concludes her explanation while holding her phone. (9) A humorous final clip shows her frantically tapping the phone screen over the finished floating effect video, mimicking the action of picking up items in a game.
